description:
Internal Sales Executive

Nottingham 29,000 - 31,000 + Annual Profit Share Bonus

Full Time Permanent Monday to Friday Office-Based

Develop Your Sales Skills with a Successful HVAC Distribution Business

Are you working in sales, customer service or a trade environment and looking for an opportunity to develop your career?

We're recruiting an Internal Sales Executive to join a successful specialist HVAC wholesaler in Nottingham, offering a competitive salary, annual profit share and the opportunity to build a long-term career within an established business.

Whether you already have internal sales experience or are looking to take the next step from a customer-facing role, this is an opportunity to develop your commercial skills, learn about a specialist industry and become part of an experienced, close-knit team.

Our client is an established specialist HVAC wholesaler supplying heating, ventilation and air conditioning products to trade and commercial customers.

The business has enjoyed significant growth in recent years and continues to develop its customer base. As part of a larger UK group, it offers the stability of an established organisation alongside the friendly working environment of a local team.

The Role

Working within the internal sales team, you'll be responsible for supporting customers, preparing quotations and proactively identifying opportunities to develop sales.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Building relationships with existing trade and commercial customers
- Handling sales enquiries via telephone and email
- Preparing quotations and following opportunities through to order
- Proactively identifying opportunities to develop existing accounts and generate new business
- Working closely with external sales colleagues to support customers
- Developing your product knowledge across the HVAC range
- Providing knowledgeable customer service and sales support

About You

We're looking for someone with a positive attitude, good communication skills and an interest in developing their career within sales.

You'll ideally have:
- Some experience in sales, customer service, retail, trade counter or a similar customer-facing role
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills
- A proactive, commercially minded approach
- Good organisational skills and attention to detail
- Enthusiasm for learning new products and developing industry knowledge
- A genuine interest in building a long-term career in internal sales

Previous experience in HVAC, plumbing and heating, technical products or wholesale would be advantageous, but isn't essential. Your attitude, reliability and willingness to learn are just as important as your previous experience.

What's on Offer?
- 29,000 - 31,000 starting salary, depending on experience
- Annual Profit Share Bonus
- 25 days' holiday plus Bank Holidays
- Monday to Friday, 8:00am - 5:00pm
- Opportunity to develop valuable B2 B sales and account management experience
- Specialist HVAC product knowledge and industry experience
- Friendly, experienced team and established customer base
- Long-term career stability within a successful business

Apply Today

If you're looking to develop your sales career and want to join an established business where you can learn, build customer relationships and become an important part of the team, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Telesales Agent
description:
This is an office-based sales role at the centre of the business. You will handle incoming enquiries, work out what the customer actually needs, quote it accurately and convert it into an order. Alongside that you will make outbound calls to existing customers, lapsed accounts and new prospects to grow the order book.

You do not need to have sold pressure gauges, regulators or electrical components before. Full product training is given and there are experienced technical colleagues alongside you. What matters is that you are confident on the telephone, accurate with detail and willing to learn a technical product properly. If you have sold anything with a part number, a specification and a trade customer on the other end of the phone, the skills carry across.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Handle inbound telephone and email enquiries, establishing the application and identifying the correct product, size, pressure range, connection and material.
- Prepare and issue accurate quotations, then follow them through to conversion rather than waiting for the customer to come back.
- Make proactive outbound calls to existing customers, lapsed accounts and new prospects to generate orders and build a pipeline.
- Process orders accurately, confirming specification, quantity, price, lead time and delivery before the order goes through.
- Build working product knowledge across gauges, regulators, air preparation equipment, thermometers, diaphragms and the electrical and electronic lines, so that customers get sound first-line advice.
- Refer complex, bespoke or custom-dial enquiries to technical colleagues, and stay with the enquiry until it is resolved.
- Support distributor and OEM accounts with pricing, availability and lead time information.
- Liaise with purchasing, production and despatch to keep customers informed, particularly where lead times move.
- Handle account queries, returns, repairs and calibration requests from first call through to resolution.
- Maintain accurate customer, contact, quotation and opportunity records on the company system.
- Follow up leads generated by the website, marketing campaigns and exhibitions.
- Record reasons for lost business and feed market and competitor intelligence back to the team.
- Work to agreed call activity, quotation and order intake targets.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Essential
- Experience in telesales, internal sales, sales support, counter sales or another telephone-based sales role. The sector matters far less than the ability.
- Confident on the telephone and comfortable picking it up to make outbound calls as well as answering them.
- Accurate and methodical, with genuine attention to detail on specification, pricing and paperwork. A wrong digit on a part number costs a delivery.
- Willing and able to learn a technical product range, and comfortable asking a question rather than guessing.
